description: 53 original fictional Sage digital employees (3 management + 50 specialists). Default website portraits use the photo style; all five styles are under assets/avatars/.

verification.framing: ID-photo standard D72 measured on every image (crown and chin), single scale-and-crop per image
verification.identity: IDs, names and roles from the Sage catalog; management IDs are MGMT-*

employees.source: Sage approved avatar collection 2026-11-05 (photo style, ID-photo framing D72)
